necessary_context.content: Complete, simply connected Riemannian manifold with nonpositive sectional curvature; Exp_y is invertible, with Log_y=Exp_y^{-1}.
necessary_context.locator: §2.1, PDF p.7; read in derived text
necessary_context.name: Hadamard manifold

necessary_context.content: For unit v, B_{y,v}(x)=lim_{t→∞}(d(Exp_y(-tv),x)-t). Extend by B_{y,rv}=r B_{y,v} for r≥0, including B_{y,0}=0. The sign convention makes the Euclidean expression <v,x-y>.
necessary_context.name: Scaled Busemann support

necessary_context.content: For every y∈M there exists v∈T_yM such that f(x)-f(y)≥B_{y,v}(x) for every x∈M; all such v constitute ∂^h f(y).
necessary_context.name: h-convexity and h-subgradient

necessary_context.content: C is compact and geodesically convex with diameter D; project each unconstrained update onto C. Theorem 6 uses bar x_0=x_0 and bar x_{k+1}=Exp_{bar x_k}(Log_{bar x_k}(x_{k+1})/(k+2)).
necessary_context.name: Constraint and averaging
